question: What is the change in the number of homeless veterans between 2012 and 2018 for each CoC region in New York that has data available in both years?
sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT CoC_Number, CoC_Name, Count_Year, SUM(Homeless_Veterans) as homeless_veterans
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE CoC_Number LIKE 'NY%' AND Count_Year IN (2012, 2018)
  GROUP BY CoC_Number, CoC_Name, Count_Year
),
counts AS (
  SELECT CoC_Number, COUNT(*) as year_count
  FROM yearly
  GROUP BY CoC_Number
)
SELECT 
  y.COC_Number,
  y.COC_Name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN y.Count_Year = 2012 THEN y.homeless_veterans END) as veterans_2012,
  MAX(CASE WHEN y.Count_Year = 2018 THEN y.homeless_veterans END) as veterans_2018,
  MAX(CASE WHEN y.Count_Year = 2018 THEN y.homeless_veterans END) - MAX(CASE WHEN y.Count_Year = 2012 THEN y.homeless_veterans END) as change
FROM yearly y
JOIN counts c ON y.COC_Number = c.COC_Number
WHERE c.year_count = 2
GROUP BY y.COC_Number, y.COC_Name
ORDER BY y.COC_Number
